signature | count
KV_EVICT_CONTAINERS | 10
FALLBACK_CASCADE_LOOP | 7

Maya Singh: i'll take GRPC_IDLE_RESET_OLD_NODES. plan: bump keepalive, roll a client patch, and mark affected nodes for reprovision. ETA 10 days.
